notes.title: Update 0.4.10
notes.content:
+Added company presets, so players can save many different companies and select them when joining the game. This also means players can rejoin the game and play a different company if something goes wrong.
+Added the ability to set what AI difficulty and personality different companies will have when a player is not playing as them (though AI is not currently functioning)
*Fixed the new week popups covering each other when ending the turn quickly
*Nodes will now start the game owning 50 of their own shares as a way to dilute shares initially (player ownership always supersedes this)
*Fixed buying shares under 51 being a way to pump and dump a node, this was because share dilution was being capped to 51 minimum
*Changed tooltips from a transparent blurred background to an opaque background
*Fixed share orders starting at the value of a previous order instead of starting at 0
*Changed the colors of the Buy Controlling and Sell All share buttons to better avoid accidental clicks
*Fixed highlighted tiles not returning to normal when placing routes

notes.title: Update 0.4.9
notes.content:
+Added quick buttons to sell all shares or buy controlling interest
+Added more tooltips to the share orders UI for estimating costs and new ownership quantities
+Nodes will now calculate their total inventory value and apply it to their share prices
+Added inventory value to the finances and logistics tabs in the node details UI
+When placing a route all accessible nodes will be highlighted
*Fixed configuring starting capital in the lobby not working
*Companies will now track what nodes they have route access to
*Effects now have their names and descriptions translated more procedurally

notes.title: Update 0.4.8
notes.content:
*Fixed an issue allowing players to send negative money to other players
*Pressing ESC will no longer bring up the ingame menu if there is a window open
*Removed some old logic that was causing lag when hitting ESC or closing a window
*Fixed nodes not updating their ownership if they were loaded before the company owning them in saved games
*Fixed the map collision box not being resized properly in saved games
*Fixed nodes recording investments on their books as revenue, thus overly inflating their share prices

notes.title: Update 0.4.7
notes.content:
+Added 3-Week Operational Expense to the node financial tab
+Added Last Dividend Payment to the node financial tab
*Replaced Average Revenue with Net Revenue in the node financial tab
*Retail nodes will now always sell for max price
*Retail nodes no longer need to set their margins
*Cities no longer care about their weekly budget (which was never being met in-game anyway)
*Cities maximum order quantity is now tied to their population
*Fixed margin sell price display showing the wrong number
*Removed internally tracking what office a node was built from
*Fixed an issue that would not allow new offices to be built if they weren't within the range of another office
*Removed several unnecessary RPC calls to reduce network congestion
*Consolidated the tech tree into fewer total taps, still separated by industry
*Fixed closing a window without using [x] not allowing that window to be reopened

notes.title: Chains of Acquisition Launch
notes.content:
Hello all!

We're excited to finally be releasing Chains of Acquisition. We hope you all will enjoy playing the full game, and we want to extend our sincere thanks (in the form of a launch sale ;)) for joining us on this journey and giving us a shot!

It's been quite a journey getting here and we are proud of how far we've come as such a small team. We have so many great ideas for the future, and we are excited to see what the community at large has in mind too!

In the meantime though, we want to get some of the quality-of-life updates out of the way to make the base game more enjoyable. Here's a small list of some of the more immediate updates we are already working on:
[list]
[*]The rest of the tutorial chapters, these are our first priority right now
[*]More optimizations, especially to load times, focused on enabling larger maps and even more complexity
[*]Fleshing out the smaller branches of the tech tree, we have 3-4 more levels immediately in the works, not including plans for a much larger tech tree expansion in the future
[*]Adding the ability to mod sounds and music
[/list]

If any of that sounds interesting, we hope you'll give the game a try, and if you have questions, suggestions, or just want to hang out, please consider joining our discord. We would love to have you!
[url=https://discord.gg/Vu9QbpaCv5]Discord Link[/url]

notes.title: Chains of Acquisition - Demo Available Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This week for Steam's Capitalism and Economy Fest we have released a demo of Chains of Acquisition. We hope you will give it a try, and we are eager to hear your feedback!

The demo is not time limited. Included are the following features:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer
[*]All base-game mechanics
[*]All starting technologies
[*]The first tab of Agriculture, Production, and Logistics technologies
[*]One map, Lakeside
[*]The map editor and custom map support
[/list]

From our testing this is enough to set up a couple small supply chains to get a feeling for how the game plays. We're excited to get more feedback on the game!

If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/My3JpAPMtY]Discord[/url]!

In the coming days and weeks we hope to release more in-depth showcases of our game's mechanics under different circumstances, so stay tuned for more!
